name: cross-seed-cleanup
description: Identifies torrents that are only used for cross-seeding and not hardlinked into a media library (Sonarr/Radarr). Compares filesystem hardlink counts against qBittorrent torrent references to find reclaimable space.

paths.name: /data
paths.description: Path to your torrent data. Must match the paths qBittorrent uses.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Host folder where log files are stored. The LOG_FILE path must point inside the container's /logs directory for logs to persist here.

variables.name: QB_HOST
variables.description: qBittorrent Web UI host (IP or hostname).

variables.name: QB_PASSWORD
variables.description: qBittorrent Web UI password. Required unless QB_API_KEY is set.

variables.name: QB_API_KEY
variables.description: qui API key for proxy authentication. Use this instead of QB_USERNAME/QB_PASSWORD.

variables.name: TAG_REMOVABLE
variables.description: Tag applied to torrents that can be safely removed.

variables.name: EXCLUDE_TAGS
variables.description: Comma-separated tags to skip (torrents with these tags are never marked removable).

variables.name: INCLUDE_CATEGORIES
variables.description: Comma-separated categories to check. If empty, all categories are checked.

variables.name: MIN_AGE_DAYS
variables.description: Only tag torrents older than this many days. 0 to disable.

variables.name: SCHEDULE
variables.description: Cron expression for scheduled runs (e.g. '0 */6 * * *' for every 6 hours). If empty, runs once and exits.

variables.name: RUN_ON_START
variables.description: Run immediately on container start before entering the cron schedule. Only applies when SCHEDULE is set.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.description: Set to false to actually apply tags. When true, only reports what would be tagged.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

variables.name: LOG_FILE
variables.description: Container path to also write logs to. Keep it under /logs so logs persist to the mapped host folder. Leave empty for stdout only.
